newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CNI sees March trade gap at $583 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CNI sees March trade gap at $583 mln.

text.p: Brazil's private National Industry Confederation (CNI) said the March trade deficit could reach $583 million.
The CNI said data for the first two months of the year showed export growth was slowing down due to lower exports of industrial products as well as increasing imports.
The trade deficit in the first two months of the year was announced at just over $2 billion.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
